name: mcp-web-validator
description: Validate HTML/CSS, audit SEO and JSON-LD, check links, and capture responsive screenshots.

tools.name: html.local
tools.description: Reads a bounded local HTML or .xhtml file and sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. .xhtml files use application/xhtml+xml parsing semantics. Use only files the user is authorized to share.

tools.name: html.url
tools.description: Fetches a bounded public HTTP(S) page, then sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. Private, reserved, credentialed, and nonstandard-port destinations are rejected.

tools.name: css.local
tools.description: Reads a bounded local CSS file and sends it to the W3C Jigsaw CSS Validator. Use only files the user is authorized to share.

tools.name: seo.metadata
tools.description: Audits supplied HTML offline for on-page SEO metadata, headings, viewport, image alternatives, and Open Graph issues. Use for a quick on-page check; use html.local/html.url for W3C HTML validation, schema.markup for JSON-LD syntax, or report.validation for a combined local-file report.

tools.name: content.duplicates
tools.description: Compares static main text across one to eight HTML pages supplied by the caller. Reports high-confidence exact matches and conservative near matches only within the same language (and script). No network requests or storage. Output is limited to this sample, not site-wide uniqueness.

tools.name: content.quality
tools.description: Offline, evidence-limited review of empty or thin static main text and substantive repeated sentences within same-language page families. Reports possible missing standalone value, not Google rankings or a semantic quality verdict. Accepts up to eight supplied HTML pages; no network, storage, browser or LLM.

tools.name: site.hreflang
tools.description: Compares head-only hreflang and canonical declarations across up to sixteen supplied static HTML pages, including x-default, reciprocal references and same-locale target consistency. No URLs are fetched, and unsampled targets are not declared broken. Works across authorized domains; no browser, files or storage.

tools.name: links.broken
tools.description: Resolves and checks up to 25 public HTTP(S) links in supplied HTML. Redirects are reported but not followed, and response bodies are discarded.

tools.name: schema.markup
tools.description: Parses JSON-LD blocks in supplied HTML locally and reports empty blocks or JSON syntax errors. It does not validate vocabulary semantics.

tools.name: schema.supported
tools.description: Offline bounded structural review of explicit JSON-LD for Article/NewsArticle/BlogPosting, Product, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Organization and WebSite. Checks limited property shapes and review-profile recommendations; unknown contexts/types stay unverified. Does not resolve remote contexts or certify Schema.org validity, Google rich-result eligibility, content truth or rankings. Use schema.markup for existing syntax-only diagnostics.

tools.name: report.validation
tools.description: Combines W3C HTML/CSS validation, local SEO/accessibility checks, JSON-LD syntax checks, and a bounded public-link check into a Markdown and structured report.

tools.name: audit.monitor
tools.description: Manual, offline, read-only P2-02 regression/optional-alert PREVIEW for two to ten existing saved audit.history IDs in oldest-first order. Configurable 1–8 sampled regressed pages, net error/warning increases, 1–4 step regression streak and review-only coverage loss/sitemap drift. Candidate alerts require complete comparable observations with unambiguous chronology; nothing is sent, scheduled, persisted, fetched or connected to GSC/GA4.

tools.name: audit.trends
tools.description: Read-only, offline longitudinal comparison of 2–10 previously saved local audit.history version IDs (oldest first). Uses only the existing compact audit archive, compares adjacent and first/last snapshots plus an exact fully-checked all-version cohort, separates coverage loss from real changes and gates issue-group disappearance on identical complete selected samples. No new site requests, archive mutations, scheduled checks or Google-indexing claims. Returns only redacted numeric evidence, never page URLs, issue messages or stored snapshots.

tools.name: audit.history
tools.description: Opt-in local-only site-audit snapshot history. Save a previous hosted audit_public_site structured result as JSON, list saved IDs, or retrieve an exact version. A single compact local JSON file retains at most 10 versions; saving the 11th removes the oldest. No database, background task, or network request.

tools.name: browser.wcag
tools.description: Local-only inert Chromium analysis of supplied HTML: sandboxed pinned headless browser, no external resource requests, scripts disabled and stripped, DOM accessible-name heuristics, aria-hidden focus, positive tabindex, custom role focusability, up to 24 real keyboard Tab focus samples, computed focus indicator review and native summary Enter toggle. Never navigates URLs, clicks links/buttons, submits forms, stores screenshots or certifies WCAG; may provision pinned browser on first use.

tools.name: media.diagnostics
tools.description: Local-only, offline review of caller-supplied HTML image alt/name evidence, responsive picture fallbacks, intrinsic dimensions, lazy loading/decoding/fetchpriority hints, video sources and caption tracks. Bounded and redacted; never fetches or renders media, executes scripts, measures layout, validates caption contents or certifies accessibility/performance.

tools.name: http.redirect_chain
tools.description: V04: review up to eight ordered HTTP response hops, Location redirects, static HTML/HTTP Link canonical declarations, and Googlebot-applicable noindex/robots observations, or probe a bounded public query-free HTTP(S) URL. Detects redirect loops, incomplete/mismatched chains, HTTP errors, canonical conflicts/cycles/chains and non-indexable sampled destinations. A destination is called wrong only relative to an explicitly supplied expected URL. Reports no raw URLs, HTML, headers, credentials, authenticated crawler observations or Google-selected canonical/indexing verdict.

tools.name: crawler.access
tools.description: V03: compare up to eight supplied pages against robots.txt group precedence and static meta/X-Robots-Tag directives for Googlebot smartphone/desktop/news/image, Bingbot and GPTBot; or probe one public page and robots.txt using only the service's own User-Agent. Distinguishes crawl disallow from explicit noindex and unavailable/ambiguous evidence. Live probe obeys site robots for this service; it does NOT impersonate/verify real crawlers, request indexing, crawl historical logs, or claim a page is indexed. Raw URLs, source and response headers are not returned.

tools.name: http.availability
tools.description: V02: compare two to 48 ordered, caller-supplied timestamped HTTP/transport outcomes, or make two to three bounded sequential public GET probes. Flags intermittent non-2xx, status transitions, 429/5xx, explicit challenge and network failures, and sampling gaps. The percentages are only ratios of sampled responses, never guaranteed uptime or actual outage duration. No scheduler, history storage, Googlebot verification or response bodies; use availability.history separately to opt into local storage.

tools.name: availability.history
tools.description: V02 local-only opt-in compact availability archive. 'capture' makes one public HTTP GET and saves only its HTTP/transport outcome and timestamp. 'list' and 'compare' read existing outcomes for exactly one authorized URL. A single 24 KB JSON archive retains a maximum of ten total observations and automatically evicts the oldest; no scheduler, Cloudflare/Google access, cloud storage, secret headers or response bodies. Capture writes local state and may evict old data.

tools.name: http.delivery
tools.description: V01: one bounded public HTTP GET probe (up to three same-origin redirects), or one to four ordered caller-supplied response observations. Diagnose 403/429/5xx, redirect completeness, HTTP cache flags, Retry-After and Cloudflare challenge evidence. No body download, JS execution, Googlebot identity verification, monitoring, raw header values or query-bearing URL output. Supply exactly one of url or observations.

tools.name: http.variants
tools.description: Offline, bounded comparison of one explicit query-free reference URL and 1–12 caller-observed same-path candidate responses across HTTP/HTTPS, apex/www, trailing slash, ASCII path case and query parameters. Reviews one-step Location, up to three canonical declarations and optional caller-computed 200-response SHA-256 fingerprints. No URL fetch, redirect following, Google canonical selection, query-value leakage or content equivalence assumptions.

tools.name: http.security
tools.description: Offline, bounded security-header/static-HTML observation review across 1–8 same-host HTTP/HTTPS pages. Distinguishes declared HTTP→HTTPS redirects, HSTS status, enforced vs report-only CSP, safe/weak referrer and framing policies, nosniff and static mixed-content/form/CSS declarations. No traffic, TLS certificate verification, browser execution, security certification or sensitive raw URL/header/HTML output.

tools.name: http.directives
tools.description: Offline, bounded analysis of one to eight caller-supplied same-origin HTTP response header observations, including PDF/media MIME types, X-Robots-Tag (scoped Googlebot directives and contradictions), Link rel=canonical declarations, Content-Disposition and response status. No URL fetch, binary download, robots.txt inspection, Google indexing assertion, or storage. Sensitive raw URLs, headers, filenames and query tokens are not returned.

tools.name: screenshot.capture
tools.description: Renders a local HTML file or HTTP(S) URL in a sandboxed local Chromium browser and writes PNG screenshots to the requested directory. Downloads the pinned headless browser on first use if it is not already cached. Existing matching files may be replaced. Completed PNG paths are included if a later viewport fails.

tools.name: content.provenance
tools.description: Offline static comparison across one to eight supplied HTML pages. Checks explicit citation IDs/URLs, dataset version and as-of claims, publication/modification dates, methodology references, and only caller-supplied freshness limits. No source is fetched, no external fact is asserted, and missing evidence remains unverified.

tools.name: content.metadata
tools.description: Offline bounded consistency check for 1-8 caller-supplied same-origin HTML pages: duplicate/conflicting title, description and canonical declarations, Open Graph/Twitter differences, explicit robots directives and repeated titles/descriptions across distinct sampled canonical preferences. Outputs review evidence, not a Google-selected canonical, indexing or ranking verdict. No network or storage.

tools.name: site.links
tools.description: Offline bounded review of one to eight caller-supplied same-origin HTML pages: contextual internal vs external links, missing accessible names, generic labels, nofollow, repeated anchors, and lexical title/H1 overlap only for supplied destinations. Unknown URLs are unverified, never called broken. No fetching, crawling, search data, JavaScript or ranking inference.

tools.name: content.competitors
tools.description: Offline comparison of one primary and up to six caller-supplied competitor pages for visible, bounded informational/commercial/transactional/navigational markup signals. Optional explicitly selected search intent and query-heading lexical overlap only. Does NOT discover competitors, fetch pages, access GSC, classify the query semantically, or predict rankings.

tools.name: product.claims
tools.description: Compare explicit local MCP product-page promises with this actual runtime's registered tool metadata. Supply HTML or one authorized public HTML URL. No arbitrary marketing semantics, no remote MCP credentials, no storage, no scripts and no claim of a successful tool invocation. Hosted tool claims must be verified by the hosted runtime.
